convert_ssd_checkpoint: convert an SSD model checkpoint file from an older mmdetection version to a newer format
parse_ssd_config: parse an SSD model config string and verify it contains a valid SSDHead bbox head type
run_ssd_version_upgrade_cli: run the SSD version upgrade CLI tool with input and output checkpoint file paths
upgrade_ssd_state_dict_keys: upgrade SSD state dict keys by remapping extra layers, l2_norm, and bbox_head entries
validate_ssd_checkpoint_meta: validate an SSD checkpoint by extracting meta info and verifying the model config is SSD-compatible
